claude_proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.object
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item targets objects, not creatures, self, areas, or marks. Its core mechanic attaches adhesive state to two chosen objects or surfaces.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: This viscous, milky-white substance can form a permanent adhesive bond between any two objects.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: bond_objects
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The surface lacks an effect atom for creating a persistent adhesive bond between two objects that prevents separation until broken by specific counters.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Once it has done so, the bond it creates can be broken only by the application of Universal Solvent or Oil of Etherealness, or with a Wish spell.
